films.title: Wadjda
films.overview: An enterprising Saudi girl signs on for her school's Quran recitation competition as a way to raise the remaining funds she needs in order to buy the green bicycle that has captured her interest.

films.title: Mary Shelley
films.overview: The love affair between poet Percy Shelley and Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin resulted in the creation of an immortal novel, “Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus.”

films.title: Nappily Ever After
films.overview: After an accident at the hair salon, Violet realizes she's not living life to the fullest. A soulful barber helps her put the pieces back together.

films.title: The Perfect Candidate
films.overview: A young Saudi doctor campaigns for a seat on the municipal council, finding confidence as she combats prejudice.
